text:
sam (oncall): quick handoff — nothing critical, just a couple things to watch before I log off in ~2h

sam (oncall): what changed: rolled a small model variant for embeddings to redwood-embed-v2-alpha at 10:20 UTC (canary = 5% traffic). No errors surfaced in health checks, but 95th latency for /embeddings spiked ~120ms above baseline during the first hour.

sam (oncall): why: looks like prefix cache warmup + slightly larger token windows from a couple heavy customers. autoscale responded, no throttles.

sam (oncall): watchlist: 
- /embeddings 95p latency elevated (keep an eye for >200ms sustained) :eyes:
- prefetch queue depth on pool-embed-g1 (use console or `redwoodctl pool inspect pool-embed-g1`)
- rolling canary for v2-alpha — if error rate >0.5% for 10m, rollback to v1 immediately

sam (oncall): action items for next shift: 
- If latency stays high after warmup (30m), toggle prefix cache TTL to 60s from 15s for pool-embed-g1 (`PATCH /pools/pool-embed-g1/config {"prefix_cache_ttl":60}`) — ping me before doing so.
- Confirm whether the two heavy customers (acct: acme-corp, acct: quickchat) are on long sequences; if so, consider applying per-customer max_seq override to reduce KV pressure.
- Approve PR #4217 (autoscale tweak) — I'll try to get it merged but may not finish before leaving.

maria: thanks sam — noted. are we confident the canary traffic routing covers europe region?

sam (oncall): yes, canary routed across us-west and eu-central, 5% each region. I double-checked routing policy in console.

kevin: FYI i'm OOO from 16:00 UTC onward, can do quick approvals until then. PR #4217 looks fine from infra side, left one comment about a wait timeout.

jen: can we add the TTL toggle to the runbook under Embeddings > Mitigations? I missed it earlier during last spike.

sam (oncall): will add short blurb and the exact curl example.

maria: if latency creeps past 200ms do we want a manual fallback to v1 across the pool or just reduce canary? what's our policy? :thinking_face:

kevin: policy = reduce canary to 1% first, then rollback pool-wide if regression persists 15m after reduction.

sam (oncall): agreed with kevin. reduce to 1% (`PATCH /canaries/redwood-embed-v2-alpha {"traffic_pct":1}`), wait 10m, if still bad -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: redwood-embed-v2-alpha @ 2026-03-17T10:20:13Z — canary=5% — (ci/cd pipeline #8241)

ops-bot: Alert watch rule created for /embeddings 95p latency > 200ms for 10m. Pager policy: oncall -> eng-sre -> pager-duty-escalate.

maria: thanks everyone. i'll keep an eye for the next 30m and ping if anything changes.

sam (oncall): small note: no customer-facing errors, so no incident bridge. leave a note in the incident log if we do the TTL toggle or reduce canary.

jen: noted, i'll update the runbook after you add the snippet. :thumbsup:

kevin: ping me on slack if you need a fast rollback, i'll be around until 16:00 UTC.

sam (oncall): thanks all — handing off to maria in ~90m. good luck! :rocket:
